sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be performed on an annually bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first draft is initiated and reviewed by 
eng. Nagy Bekheit Saleh,
accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad 
general director, 
 approved by eng. عبد الكريم أبو زيد إسماعيل؛ رئيس 
قطاع محطة توليد الكهرباء الهيدروليكية بالسد العالي, and certified by by 
eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem: HPGC inspection and quality control general 
director..
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required
Wear safety equipment as helmet, shoes etc
Switch of the A-C current
Put the suitable warning sign

Tools set, cleaning materials (cloth - benzine), grease

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Clean commutator, slip 
ring, brushes for motors

Check the bearing of the 
motors and replace them if there is any damage in them

Clean and inspect the main 
contacts of the contactors

Inspect and clean the 
resistors of the rotor
Check the control circuit

Inspect and check the 
brake of the motors

Make revision for the 
motors of the supporters
